title: I'm Back: Building AI in Public
content:
[TITLE: I'm Back - Building AI in Public]

[HOOK: face to camera, tight close-up]
For a year, I was just BUILDING.
Today... I'm back.

[CAM: medium shot]
But this time, it's not just AI news.
I'm going to build REAL AI products...
and show you the whole process, right here.

[SCREEN: VS Code + terminal]
The code. The architecture.
The bugs... and how I FIX them.
And at the end... the final product.
No polished highlight reel. The real thing.

[CAM: close-up]
Quick intro, since a lot of you are new here.
I'm a software developer.
My focus is AI engineering, full-stack systems...
and AUTOMATION.
Basically, I take AI out of the demo
and turn it into something people can actually use.

[SCREEN: project folder "ai-knowledge-assistant"]
So what's the first project?
An AI KNOWLEDGE ASSISTANT.
You give it your documents...
and it answers your questions from them... with the SOURCE.
Not a guess. Not a made-up answer.
An answer you can check.

[CAM: face]
Here's how this channel works now.
Every day... one thing I built, or one thing I learned.
What worked, I'll show you.
What FAILED... I'll show you that too.
Because honestly, the failures are where you learn the most.

[CAM: medium shot]
If you're learning AI right now...
or you want to use AI in your own work or your business...
this journey is for you.
You'll see every decision I make, and why I make it.
And you can build along with me.

[CAM: face, smile]
It's been a long year of quiet work.
Now it's time to share it.
And this time, I'm doing it out loud, one build at a time.

[CTA: point to follow button]
FOLLOW for daily AI...
explained by a builder.
